newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's Candle plans A$14 mln raising.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's Candle plans A$14 mln raising.

text.p: Australian personal agency and employment contractor Candle Australia Ltd said on Monday it plans to raise A$14 million in a share offer to list on the Australian Stock Exchange.
Candle said the shares to be offered were priced at A$1.00 each. The company would have a market capitalisation of A$24.5 million following the float. The offer closes on December 19.
It said the directors planned to pay a final fully franked dividend of 3.9 cents for the six months ended June 30, 1997.
The group specialises in personnel recruitment in the informational technology and telecommunications sectors.
Candle reported normalised earnings before interest and tax (EBIT) of A$3.4 million, up 48 percent from A$2.3 million a year earlier.
In its prospectus, Candle forecast EBIT of A$4.6 million for 1996/97.
Revenue was expected to rise to A$68.9 million in 1996/97.
